name: hsv
title: color.hsv
lead: Makes a colour from hue, saturation and value, each 0 to 1.
signature: color.hsv(h: number, s: number, v: number) → Color

usedIn.quote: local c = color(1, 0, 0.5)   -- or colors.red, color.hsv(0.6, 1, 1)
local rainbow = function(letter, i, n, t) return { color = color.hsv((i - 1) / n + t, 1, 1) } end
